text: Si Men meeɗinirii sirkooɓe ɓen neema toɓo e amo ɓaawo nde hokkere e ɓiɗtteende heɓiɓe, jaka yoo hiɓe jalkita fenna Aayeeje Amen ɗen. An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓenn sirkooɓe : "Ko Alla ɓuri yaccaade fewjoore, ɓuri yaawude kadi nanngugol on lepta". Pellet, Malaa'ikaaɓe winndooɓe ɓen hino winndude ko fewjoton kon, huunde e munlaawa- taako ɓe, ko honno ɗum laaworta taguɗo ɓe on? Alla yoɓitoyay on e pewje mon ɗen.
